runs.question: Which OMB memo currently governs how federal agencies acquire AI, and what happened to the earlier acquisition memo?

answer.text:
OMB Memorandum M-25-22, "Driving Efficient Acquisition of Artificial Intelligence in Government," is the current governing memo in these documents. It is dated April 3, 2025. It provides guidance to agencies to improve their ability to acquire AI responsibly.

The earlier acquisition memo was M-24-18, "Advancing the Responsible Acquisition of Artificial Intelligence in Government." M-25-22 rescinds and replaces M-24-18. M-24-18 was issued September 24, 2024 (dated September 24, 2024), although the title in the collection lists it as October 2024.

Because M-25-22 replaces M-24-18, M-24-18 no longer governs. The M-24-18 passages in the collection describe its content but should be read as superseded.
